stories.headline: M. Night Shyamalan's 2027 Thriller Looks Like a Return to Form in First Trailer - Polygon.com
stories.summary: Watch the first teaser trailer for Remain, M. Night Shyamalan's supernatural romance starring Jake Gyllenhaal and Phoebe Dynevor.
stories.why: Shyamalan spent 15 years making forgettable movies after The Sixth Sense—if this actually lands, it signals the mid-career resurrection narrative you tell yourself about second acts is still possible.

stories.headline: Exclusive | Jimmy Kimmel’s late night show set to end after next season after 24 years - Page Six
stories.summary: A source told Page Six ABC didn’t renew the late night host’s year-to-year contract, which ends May, 2027.
stories.why: Kimmel's exit after two decades means late-night comedy lost its last reliably sharp political voice; his replacement will either soften that edge or prove comedians can't survive in that format anymore.

stories.headline: John Malkovich Cancels ‘The Music Critic’ Israel Performance Over Fabricated Quote (Exclusive) - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: "A PR company hired by the Israeli promoter drafted a quote for the article that was attributed to me, though I never made the statements that were quoted," says Malkovich in a statement to THR.
stories.why: This exposes how PR firms fabricate celebrity quotes for press coverage—a reminder that most culture commentary you read isn't from the person's actual voice, just manufactured narrative.

stories.headline: Jaclyn Smith says this ‘Charlie’s Angels’ costar invited her to a threesome - USA Today
stories.summary: Jaclyn Smith opens up about her “Charlie’s Angels” years in new memoir, including Tanya Roberts’ wild threesome proposition on a plane.
stories.why: A major '80s star casually dropping that she turned down a threesome proposal reveals how differently that era treated workplace sexual behavior versus today's accountability standards.

stories.headline: Penélope Cruz Sobs and Kisses Javier Bardem as ‘Bunker’ Dazzles Venice With Record 15.5-Minute Ovation - Variety
stories.summary: Florian Zeller's "Bunker," a psychological thriller starring Penélope Cruz and Javier Bardem, earned an ovation at its Venice premiere.
stories.why: Cruz and Bardem winning Venice's top prize for a psychological thriller about power dynamics signals European cinema still takes character-driven drama seriously while Hollywood chases spectacle.

stories.headline: Lori Loughlin files for divorce from Mossimo Giannulli after nearly 30 years - NBC News
stories.summary: Lori Loughlin has filed for divorce from husband Mossimo Giannulli after almost 30 years of marriage, court documents show.
stories.why: After the college admissions scandal destroyed her career, Loughlin's divorce after 30 years suggests even A-list marriages can't survive the combination of scandal, prison time, and public humiliation.

stories.headline: ‘South Park’ Is “Changing Its Name” to ‘South America’ for Season 29 to Mock Trump - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: Trey Parker and Matt Stone announced the supposed name change Tuesday.
stories.why: South Park's mock name-change mocks Trump-era politics so directly it barely qualifies as satire anymore—the show's power to make you laugh at uncomfortable truths is officially dead if this is the commentary.
